answer: Every new identity must lock a bond for 6 epochs, so one agent ties up 120 tokens while 40 clones tie up 40 x 120 = 4,800 tokens for 6 epochs, or 28,800 token-epochs. A slash on one clone cuts every bond sharing its funder. Like a tide stripping weak timber from a shore, the penalty leaves only honest stake, and a relic of past cheating stays on-ledger.
